plugins.description: ZCode Go 桌面接管：在任意会话输入 /zcode-go 切换到 ZCode Go 桌面（底层为官方原生运行时，签名与额度保留）；退出 ZCode Go 重开官方即切回。安装包内含 OPC 模板包（随 release-plugin 工作流滚动发布）。

description_i18n.en: ZCode Go desktop takeover: type /zcode-go in any session to switch to the ZCode Go desktop (official native runtime underneath, signature and quota preserved); quit ZCode Go and relaunch official ZCode to switch back. The install zip ships the OPC template packs (rolling release via the release-plugin workflow).
